llm_response.reason: The website claims to sell luxury dance and fashion items associated with the brand 'Repetto' but shows an absence of transparent company information and specific business contact; instead, it only displays generic e-commerce trust-building language (secure payment, free returns) without evidence of legitimacy. The navigation lacks standard credibility sections (About Us, Contact, Policy details), and there is no publicly verifiable proof this is an authorized Repetto reseller. These factors match several scam website characteristics: non-existent or unverifiable company info, handling of branded goods outside official channels, and ambiguous customer information policies. External reputation checks and WHOIS validation failed, but on-page evidence is sufficiently suspect.
